body:
Personal note: the insecticide crew crossed at dawn, leaving yellow dust on the grass. The deer fled before the county trucks reached the trail.

I saved it from the bag of rubbish because there was a name on the reverse. The name was not on the list they posted.

It could be a mistake in the copying. The things stacked beside the page were real enough, and still waiting to be moved.
title: torn note from the north trail

body: The north trail was marked clear after the patrol turned back halfway. I asked why my brother’s campsite appeared on the completed section. The ranger said the box only had room for one kind of mark.
title: A patrol in pencil
